ekbom syndrome: Ekbom syndrome is feeling of uneasiness and restlessness in the legs after going to bed.
Ekbom syndrome means the same as restless legs syndrome or restless legs.
ekg: EKG is a graphical recording of the cardiac cycle produced by an electrocardiograph.
EKG means the same as electrocardiogram or cardiogram or ECG.
ekman: Ekman is Swedish oceanographer who recognized the role of the Coriolis effect on ocean currents.
Ekman means the same as Vagn Walfrid Ekman.
eke out: To eke out means to supplement what is thought to be deficient.
For example: "He eked out his meager pay by giving private lessons."
Eke out can also mean live from day to day, as with some hardship.
Eke out can also mean make by laborious and precarious means.
Eke out means the same as fill out or squeeze out.
